dataQuality.title: 处理有问题的数据
dataQuality.description: 核对重复、缺失或冲突，记录保留、去重或排除的理由。

pairedEvaluation.title: 设计可复核的对照评测
pairedEvaluation.description: 用同一批案例和同一套规则比较两个方案，单独记录权限错误。

scopeOfConclusion.title: 判断结论的适用范围
scopeOfConclusion.description: 说明现有证据能支持什么判断，标出还需要数据或测试的部分。

correlateLogs.title: 串联日志线索
correlateLogs.description: 用账号、主机和会话对齐日志，再核对事件之间的关系。

triageAlert.title: 判断告警是否需要升级
triageAlert.description: 结合已关联的证据，记录关闭告警或提交进一步核验的理由。

compareRecovery.title: 用可比指标排查故障
compareRecovery.description: 在同一观察窗口比较错误率和资源使用情况，定位异常范围。

rollbackDecision.title: 为上线异常制定回退方案
rollbackDecision.description: 先界定候选组的影响范围，再决定何时暂停扩量或发起回退。

dataQuality.title: Handle data quality problems
dataQuality.description: Check for duplicates, missing values, or conflicts and record why each entry was kept, deduplicated, or excluded.

pairedEvaluation.title: Design a reproducible comparison
pairedEvaluation.description: Evaluate two approaches with the same cases and criteria, and track authorization errors separately.

scopeOfConclusion.title: Set the scope of a conclusion
scopeOfConclusion.description: State what the evidence supports and identify what still needs more data or testing.

correlateLogs.title: Connect clues across logs
correlateLogs.description: Align log entries by account, host, and session, then check how the events relate.

triageAlert.title: Decide when to escalate alerts
triageAlert.description: Use correlated evidence to record why an alert should be closed or escalated for verification.

compareRecovery.title: Diagnose incidents with comparable metrics
compareRecovery.description: Compare error rates and resource usage across the same observation window to locate the affected scope.

rollbackDecision.title: Plan a rollback when a release degrades
rollbackDecision.description: Identify the affected rollout group and decide when to pause expansion or initiate a rollback.
